minor.issue: Missing key_id/nonce/signature returns 422 (Pydantic validation), not 400/403. Acceptable but inconsistent with /api/ideas/inbox which returns 422 too — fine.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L6744-6781 /api/ideas/send — anonymous path correctly catches HTTPException from _verify_signed and falls back to sender_label='Anonyme' rather than 403'ing. Content stripped, no min-length per iter55 spec. sender_ip_hash is sha256[:16] truncated → fine for analytics, not PII-leaking.
server.py L6784-6789 /api/ideas/mine — projection {'_id': 0} correctly strips Mongo ObjectId. Query filters strictly on sender_key_id of the signing device → isolation verified runtime via test_05.

server.py L7114-7166 /api/auth/theft-email-request — anti-enum done right: 200 returned in both the user-exists and user-missing branches, token only inserted when user_exists, Resend send wrapped in try/except so a Resend failure can never escape as 500 to the caller. Magic-link TTL = 30 min, single-use enforced via 'used' flag in theft_email_tokens collection.

server.py L7169-7188 /api/auth/theft-email-confirm — 404 on missing-or-used, 410 on expired (>1800s), 200 + revoked_count on valid. Atomically marks token used=True after revoking the device_keys rows (role creator/approved → role 'revoked' with revoked_at + revoked_reason='theft_email_recovery'). Good audit trail.

Login.js L492-500 toolbar — `fixed top-3 inset-x-3 z-30 flex items-center justify-between` correctly splits TheftButton+AccountsButton (left) vs DeviceKeyCopyButton+MessageButton (right). pointer-events-none on the wrapper with pointer-events-auto on children — clean a11y.

Landing.js L65-76 — TheftButton + AccountsButton on the left, MessageButton on the right. AccountsButton component internally checks role and returns null for non-creator → why the fresh visitor in our test sees nothing on the left (only Discover + TheftButton). Working as designed.
